title: TSB's big-bang migration locked out 1.9 million customers
body: In 2018 TSB moved millions of accounts from its old bank's platform to a new one over one weekend; customers faced broken balances and access for weeks, and the migration's testing and readiness were later criticised by regulators, who fined the bank heavily. Big-bang cutovers concentrate all discovery into production. Phased migration exists precisely because weekends cannot be rolled back.
